info.title: Dahua Access Control API
info.description: Complete REST OpenAPI specification generated from all routers mounted in backend version 1.1.4. The legacy People and IC Cards router and standalone Network router are intentionally not mounted. The required device initialization interface route remains available. Device WebSocket /ws/devices is documented in NEXTJS_FRONTEND_API_HANDOFF.md.

post.summary: Adopt an existing person-based card into a station role
post.description: Copies an existing cloud AccessCard assignment into the station-based USER/STAFF model. It does not enroll, modify, or delete anything on the physical controller and does not delete the legacy person/card records. Use this after reviewing the role, then run the confirmed factory-reset reprovision action to restore cards to a controller known to be empty.

Remove orphaned cloud station-card rows without contacting the controller.

This is a guarded cleanup tool, not part of normal user/card management.
Rows with any user-card history are protected so audit ownership is kept.

post.summary: Confirm cards manually when controller inventory readback is unsupported
post.description: Use only after an administrator has checked every expected card in SmartPSS/device management and physically tested access with each card. The supplied card-number list must exactly match the cloud assignments. This closes a verification-required restore job without pretending that the unsupported SDK inventory API succeeded.

post.description:
Reactivate a previously assigned card without creating a new card record.

A new UserCardAssignment history row is created; the old inactive link is
retained with its original ended_at timestamp. The controller card itself
is updated in place and must be inventory-verified afterwards.

StationCardAdoptRequest.title: StationCardAdoptRequest
StationCardAdoptRequest.description:
Link an existing person-based card to a station role without re-enrolling it.

The legacy AccessCard row remains intact for compatibility and history. The
new station assignment is the cloud-owned record used for USER/STAFF
reporting and post-reset reprovisioning.
